text:
Morgan (support): Heads-up — AcmeCorp opened a ticket (ACME-4123). They need chat streaming that can interleave tool/function calls and emit structured JSON fragments progressively. Link: https://support.redwood.com/tickets/ACME-4123

Alex (product): Quick clarifying q: do they need tool results as separate events while the model continues generating, or just an ordered sequence where the model waits for tool output?

Morgan (support): They want true interleaving. Example: model calls search tool, returns partial search hits as they arrive, continues generation, and emits structured `status` objects mid-stream. Low latency is a must.

Jamie (eng): Noted. Current runtime streams token tokens; we don't have an established framing for typed events mid-stream. Two main approaches: 1) JSON framed stream with envelope types (chunk/tool_start/tool_event/structured_fragment) over the streaming endpoint, or 2) keep token stream but push tool events over a parallel webhook/socket. Both have tradeoffs. :thinking:

Karen (sales): Customer will pay for dedicated capacity if needed. They prefer single connection over juggling webhooks.

Jamie (eng): Technical constraints: interleaving requires runtime to multiplex generator tokens with tool execution output. Need ordering guarantees and backpressure handling. Also need to define failure modes — what happens if a tool fails mid-stream?

Alex (product): Proposed contract: add a new optional param `response_mode=framed_stream` and `framing=event_sse|jsonl` (default `token` to preserve backward compatibility). Framed stream uses typed envelopes: { "type":"token|tool_call|tool_progress|structured_fragment|done", "payload": ... }. Acceptance criteria: sample SDKs, error semantics doc, and 95th pctl latency within SLO for supported models.

Samir (ux): I'll produce two UI patterns: 1) merged timeline (tokens + tool events inline), 2) two-pane (model stream + side-channel tool progress). Will post mocks by Wed.

Jamie (eng): Rough implementation plan: - design doc/RFC (this week) - runtime multiplexing + test harness (2 sprints) - small beta with Dedicated customers (2 sprints) - hosted rollout after perf tuning. MVP scope: framed_stream over HTTP SSE with envelope schema, tool events as separate envelope types, and a `resume_token` for recovery. Estimate 6-8 weeks for MVP.

Alex (product): Launch checklist (must before GA): docs + examples, SDK support (node/py), tenancy/permission checks for tool execution, metrics (per-event latency, percentage tool failures), and migration guide for existing customers. Also define default backoff if tool fails mid-stream (recommendation: emit `structured_fragment` with `error` and continue).

Morgan (support): Customer OK with being beta participant. Wants canary asap. Assigned to Morgan to coordinate.

Karen (sales): Can we offer an interim workaround: streaming tokens + progress webhooks for tool events? Might unblock them in 2 weeks.

Jamie (eng): Yes — we can ship webhook-based progress as short-term solution while framed_stream is built. Will add to design doc as "interim integration".

Ops-Bot: deploy-notice: planning meeting scheduled Fri 10:00 for prioritization.

Alex (product): Action items: Jamie - tech RFC by EOD Fri (owner). Samir - UI mocks by Wed. Morgan - confirm customer beta terms by Tue. Alex - add to roadmap sprint planning and draft launch criteria. Karen - confirm commercial terms if beta moves to Dedicated.

Jamie (eng): Quick example envelope (SSE style) for reference:

```
event: token
data: {"text":"The model continues..."}

event: tool_start
data: {"tool":"search","call_id":"c123"}

event: tool_progress
data: {"call_id":"c123","hits":[{"id":1,"title":"..."}],"partial":true}

event: structured_fragment
data: {"schema":"search_summary.v1","data":{"total":42}}

event: done
data: {"status":"ok"}
```

Jamie (eng): Notes: make sure SDKs surface typed events and provide an iterator over envelopes rather than raw token strings.

Alex (product): OK — this gives us a clear path. Prioritization: mark as P1 for customer-driven beta; final GA depends on performance numbers. :+1:

Morgan (support): Thanks — I'll update the ticket with the beta plan and link to the RFC when ready. :eyes:
